title: TaskClassDefinition
description: Declares a task class — a named category of work with its default workflow, routing matchers, and risk classification. Stored as YAML in recipes/task_classes/.

name.description: Canonical task class identifier, snake_case. Must be unique across the registry.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what kinds of tasks belong to this class.

artifact_contract_ref.description: Name of the artifact_contract (must match artifact_contract.schema.json task_class) that governs outputs for this class.

default_workflow.description: Name of the workflow (must exist in workflow registry) used when no override is provided.

matches.description: Routing matchers. The task router evaluates these in order: keywords → regex → path_globs. First match wins.

keywords.description: Case-insensitive keywords found in the task title or description that suggest this class.

regex.description: POSIX ERE patterns applied to the task title + description concatenation.

path_globs.description: Glob patterns matched against files expected to be touched. Useful for routing by filesystem scope.

default_gates.description: Gate IDs applied by default to every run of this class. Can be augmented per-workflow-node.

risk_class.description: Risk tier: low (auto-promote ok), medium (shadow + benchmark before promote), high (human gate required), critical (dual human approval + immutable safety constraint check).

max_parallel_runs.description: Maximum concurrent runs of this class. 0 = unlimited.

budget_cap_usd.description: Per-run cost ceiling in USD. 0 = inherit global default.
